sources.label: Official Brooks Running size guide (Women, Tops)

notes: Premium running brand. Brooks's women's tops chart uses letter sizes with chest, waist and hip ranges; it prints no UK, US or EU sizes. Running tops and shorts cut slim for performance. Jackets and warm-up gear slightly more relaxed. Popular secondhand among runners.
audit: Old /en_gb/size-chart is 'page not found'; guide is /en_gb/main-size-guide/ (Women, Tops, Size chart). Printed chest stored as bust. cm tab has XS-XXL; XXS only appears on the inches tab, so XXS is converted at 2.54, originals in _in. Old XS 82/63/87 now 79-84/61-66/86-91; M 90/71/95 now 89-94/71-76/97-102; XL 101/82/106 now 102-112/86-97/109-122. XXS, XXL added; UK/US/EU removed (not printed).
